title: Decision locks signed off
summary: Initial program decisions D1–D8, D10, D11 locked as L11–L20; firewall, harness, and stratification rules set.

title: Foundational program (Phase 0–3)
summary: Built the corpus pipeline, validation harness, and annotation dataset; ran baseline morphology/topic/anchor studies and the first living synthesis.

title: Replication gate passed
summary: 35/38 scored published-baseline statistics reproduced (h2, MZ peak, glyph rules within tolerance); the replication firewall gate passed.

title: Annotation gate passed
summary: 227-page bulk annotation at schema v0.2-fine accepted; QA passed retuned thresholds; root_type flagged low-confidence.

title: Synthesis gate passed
summary: First living-synthesis flagship accepted with graded claims.

title: Final i01 gate passed
summary: Post-adversarial-review honest revision accepted; i02 agenda approved; i01 complete.

title: Sharpening the envelope by subtraction (E1–E5)
summary: Word-order/meaning-detector claims tested and corrected; the i01 'conlang best fit' was withdrawn under fair encoding-bracket tuning.

title: Is ΔI a meaning detector?
summary: ΔI value is not a meaning certificate; a meaningless drift-null reaches the same ΔI at the wrong scale, so ΔI cannot settle meaningful-vs-meaningless.

title: Word-order signal confound
summary: Reordering signal is intrinsic (block scale 812), not an artifact; the anti-cipher point was corrected — a deterministic type-preserving verbose cipher retains ΔI, reopening that cipher family.

title: Anchor-hunt power curve
summary: The 'null informative' claim was oversold; the null excludes only strong balanced anchors, weakening the flagship anchor leg.

title: root↔leaf masked positive
summary: An apparent cross-organ visual bundle; the coded 'confirmed' verdict was overclaimed and corrected to suggestive-but-unresolved after a cross-model test.

title: root↔leaf same-source confound test
summary: Opus-4.8 re-annotation showed the association rides on Sonnet's root label; graded down B→C — leaned toward a labelling artifact.

title: Fair encoding bracket
summary: Under equal tuning and held-out scoring, no encoding family is robustly distinguished; i01's 'conlang best fit' withdrawn, two bugs caught en route.

title: Reconstruction + variable-introduction agenda (E6–E10)
summary: Hardened negatives (no family distinguished, no statistic localizes meaning) while reopening the root↔leaf candidate; excluded verbose cipher but revived the abjad class.

title: Verbose/nomenclator cipher reconstruction
summary: Verbose cipher deductively excluded on the ED1 morphology network; an abjad of real Latin reaches it, refuting the first-pass 'needs constructed morphology' and reviving the abjad class.

title: Fine-granularity anchor hunt
summary: 18 raw anchor 'discoveries' were caught by the permutation null (p=0.48); no anchor above chance at higher power. Anti-labelled-herbal null holds.

title: Whitened encoding bracket
summary: The whitened ranking is a regularisation artifact (ill-conditioned covariance); no family stably distinguished. The 'whitening confirms E5' claim was withdrawn.

title: VMS-coordinate meaning localization
summary: After two refutations of trivial endpoints, no structural axis localizes meaning — the structured-meaningless adversary out-scores meaningful text and the VMS sits below both; a pre-registered commitment was retracted.

title: root↔leaf third vision-model rater
summary: Haiku 4.5 also reproduced the leaf association, overturning E4b's 'Sonnet-specific artifact'; root↔leaf reopened as strongest referential candidate but unconfirmed.

title: Post-i02/i03 synthesis accepted
summary: Tim signed off the honest post-review synthesis (E1–E10 folded in); L37 locked and forward direction set.

title: E10 confirm-or-kill (E11–E12)
summary: The root↔leaf bundle survived a style control but the independence test showed model annotation is underpowered/untestable; E10's positive candidate withdrawn to UNRESOLVED.

title: Illustration-style control for root↔leaf
summary: The bundle survives conditioning on palette-richness style for both models; not a palette-style artifact (partial control only).

title: Independent-lineage (GPT-5.1) root rater
summary: A non-Anthropic rater does not reproduce the association; a first-pass 'KILLED' was corrected to UNRESOLVED-underpowered — model annotation cannot adjudicate, only a human panel can.

title: Mid-level linguistic program (E13–E17)
summary: Built a null-correction framework; found the VMS lacks the surface content>function collocation gap and has weak word-class structure, with A/B differing lexically not grammatically.

title: Function/content bimodality probe
summary: Three global operationalisations failed calibration; no VMS verdict issued (harness-first). Prompted the E13b redesign.

title: Function/content, order-shuffle null
summary: Calibrated; narrowed to a surface finding — the VMS has near-chance collocation and its most-frequent words are template-like, the opposite of flat function words. First substantive i05 result.

title: Distributional word-class induction
summary: Null-corrected POS induction shows the VMS has only weak word-class structure (~0.13–0.19× real language), calibrated on real languages.

title: Content-controlled A-vs-B contrast
summary: The apparent A/B word-class difference vanishes within the herbal section — it is a section/content confound, not dialect; corrects E14b as E12 corrected E10.

title: Paper v1 preprint
summary: First firewall-sourced MS408 preprint packaged via the package-paper skill (through E12).

title: Paper v2 (folds i05)
summary: Preprint updated to fold in the i05 mid-level linguistic program.

title: Cryptanalytic direction (E18–E20)
summary: Concluded the cipher-of-real-prose class is EXCLUDED via the joint low-entropy + retained-ΔI + weak-syntax signature; this universal headline was later retracted by i11.

title: Joint-signature cipher test
summary: No cipher of real prose matches the VMS's low-h2 + weak-syntax combination; the negative is grade B and the circular 'favours generation' positive was dropped.

title: Language-universality control
summary: The exclusion holds across typologically diverse languages including Hebrew (a native abjad); an order-scrambling transposition cipher is the only surviving weak-syntax lead.

title: Transposition closure
summary: Retained-ΔI and weak-syntax are mutually exclusive under any word-reordering cipher, yet the VMS has both — closing the cipher-of-real-prose class (headline later retracted).

title: Paper v3 (folds i06)
summary: Preprint updated to fold in the i06 cryptanalytic direction (carried the later-retracted cipher exclusion headline).

title: Characterising the generative class (E21–E22)
summary: A context-free positional/template generator matches entropy + block-ΔI + weak-positive syntax but never morphology connectivity, lexical reuse, or frequency slope — a partial account only.

title: Minimal positional generator + ablation
summary: A first-pass 'class sufficiency [B]' was overturned by the refutation pass — constants were grid-selected to the VMS bands and the weak-syntax leg was shuffle-passable — narrowed to an informative negative.

title: Genericity/coupling sweep
summary: A broad a-priori grid never reaches the VMS's ED1, TTR, or Zipf; the context-free bag-of-slots is INSUFFICIENT and demands an added reuse/smaller-lexicon mechanism.

title: Adding frequency concentration (E23–E24)
summary: Across three generative families, none reproduces the full 8-axis signature over the swept ranges; the summary statistics are mutually coupled. This hard constraint was later walked back by i09.

title: Paper v4 (folds i07–i08)
summary: Preprint folds the generative-class characterisation with refutation-corrected wording.

title: Symbols-as-values direction (E27–E28)
summary: The quantitative-register hypothesis finds no support and closes at grade D — a positional-numeral sub-type is shape-excluded and no robust ordinal anchor appears in the zodiac rings.

title: Symbol quantification
summary: The VMS's strong positional specialisation (0.74) shape-excludes a positional-numeral sub-type; a non-positional value scheme remains untouched (→ E28).

title: Angular/ordinal anchor in circular diagrams
summary: A sensitivity-confirmed Mantel test on all 12 zodiac rings finds no robust ordinal structure; the lone f73r hit is not reproduced — register stays D.

title: Is the i08 coupling real? (E25–E26)
summary: With ED1 made an independent knob, i08's gross incompatibility collapses to a shallow ~0.03 near-miss frontier — a retraction of the i08 hard constraint, not a promotion to 'no constraint'.

title: Decoupled-ED1 type-lexicon generator
summary: Making ED1 an independent knob shows E24's saturation was a small-char-space artifact; the coupling largely dissolves to a shallow h2↔ED1 near-miss (initial over-read later curbed).

title: Word-length variance vs the h2↔ED1 frontier
summary: Word-length variance lands ED1 in-band jointly with ΔI/TTR/Zipf; the residual is a ~0.03 h2 near-miss plus a fixable length artifact — the frontier is all-but-crossed.

title: Paper v5 then v5b
summary: Preprint folds i09; v5's stronger 'signature doesn't constrain mechanism' phrasing was corrected by a refutation of the walk-back itself to v5b.

title: Methods paper v1 then v2
summary: Packaged the transferable adversarial-self-correction methodology paper; v1's inferential over-claims were corrected to v2 by its own refutation pass, and the refutation archive was created.

title: Naibbe cipher vs the i06 discriminators
summary: A first pass read 'i06 confirmed [B]'; the refutation killed it — word-boundary Latin sits in the VMS ΔI band and ~82% of Naibbe's ΔI loss is respacing, exposing that ΔI is a homophony detector and weakening i06's ΔI leg.

title: Cipher exclusion re-examination (multi-seed)
summary: On word-boundary Latin: order-preserving ciphers robustly EXCLUDED (strong syntax), but verbose+homophonic (≈ Naibbe) NOT excluded — i06's universal cipher headline RETRACTED, robust core kept.

title: Harden the fc_z/wc_z syntax discriminators
summary: Deconfounded syntax measures firm the order-preserving exclusion (6.8σ/8.0σ after v6b correction of a fabricated ~30σ); the homophonic class stays inconclusive. A recalled-number firewall slip was caught and corrected.

title: i06 universal cipher headline retracted
summary: The 'cipher-of-real-prose EXCLUDED' headline (papers v3–v5b) is retracted to 'order-preserving ciphers excluded; verbose+homophonic (Naibbe-class) not excluded' — the VMS-as-cipher hypothesis is viable on the program's own analysis.

title: Paper v6 then v6b + methods v3
summary: Paper v6 retracts the i06 cipher exclusion; its own refutation caught a fabricated ~30σ and over-correction → v6b, and methods v3 adds the i06/Naibbe self-correction example.

title: Open-source release Tier 0
summary: Repo packaged as a public evaluator: ms408.evaluate() API, firewall-clean reference bands, Apache-2.0 license, docs; 174 tests pass. A subsample-without-replacement bug fix put the VMS back inside its own bands.

title: Engaging concurrent work (Naibbe/Parisel) + release
summary: The make-or-break Naibbe engagement exposed and corrected i06's ΔI-leg confound and retracted the universal cipher headline; also shipped the open-source release tiers and arXiv bundles.

title: Block-scale like-for-like ΔI
summary: A first pass wrongly found a homophonic cipher reaching the VMS corner ('ΔI leg dead'); the refutation showed the corner was a homophony-marker h2 artifact — under a fair model no config reaches it, so block-scale ΔI weakly separates verbose+homophonic ciphers.

title: Open-source release Tier 1
summary: Value-pinning tests, a Naibbe worked example, a reproduce-the-paper --verify path, and CI added to the public evaluator.

title: Open-source release Tier 2
summary: Hardened CI, CONTRIBUTING, tutorial, and wired docs; Tier-2 packaging marked done.

title: arXiv submission bundles prepared
summary: Build/check arXiv submission bundles prepared for paper v6b and methods v3 (no submission yet).

title: Paper v7
summary: Preprint folds the E33 block-scale ΔI result and announces the open-source release.

title: Public GitHub Pages site
summary: Scoped and shipped the Astro v1 public site (docs + papers), later extended with a library/education portal and media feed.

title: H2-2026 publication planning package
summary: Venue landscape, scoring rubric, and four pathways for placing the constraint-envelope (Paper A, v7) and methods (Paper B, v3) papers; every venue rejects perceived 'solutions' and welcomes the hypothesis-shrinking posture.
